title: KAP Fundamentals Explorer
description: Annual KAP fundamentals from the stock-crawler SQL views. Currency/company/year filtering, exact values, comparisons and collection details.

options.content: **Choose Currency → Company → Fiscal year.** All selected years appear in the table; charts compare individual company-year records. Consolidated statements are preferred when both scopes exist. Tables use **base currency units**; monetary charts use **millions of ${currency}**. Refresh reads stored SQL data and does not start a crawl.

panels.title: SQL connection
panels.description: A green Connected confirms a SQL session. A red error identifies a connection problem; it does not mean the financial values are missing.

panels.title: Companies with selected data
panels.description: Count of distinct companies with rows matching all filters.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT v.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY v.company_id, v.fiscal_year
               ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.consolidation_scope = 'consolidated' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                        v.period_end_date DESC, v.report_id DESC
           ) AS scope_rank
    FROM dbo.vw_fundamentals AS v
    WHERE v.market_source = 'kap_compare'
      AND v.fiscal_period = 4
      AND v.currency_code IN (${currency:sqlstring})
      AND v.ticker IN (${company:sqlstring})
      AND CAST(v.fiscal_year AS varchar(4)) IN (${year:sqlstring})
), selected AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE scope_rank = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) AS [Companies] FROM selected;

panels.title: Annual fundamentals · all selected periods
panels.description: Exact stored base-unit amounts. Scroll horizontally for more columns. No sum footer is used because adding annual snapshots across years is misleading.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT v.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY v.company_id, v.fiscal_year
               ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.consolidation_scope = 'consolidated' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                        v.period_end_date DESC, v.report_id DESC
           ) AS scope_rank
    FROM dbo.vw_fundamentals AS v
    WHERE v.market_source = 'kap_compare'
      AND v.fiscal_period = 4
      AND v.currency_code IN (${currency:sqlstring})
      AND v.ticker IN (${company:sqlstring})
      AND CAST(v.fiscal_year AS varchar(4)) IN (${year:sqlstring})
), selected AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE scope_rank = 1
)
SELECT ticker AS [Company], fiscal_year AS [Year], currency_code AS [Currency],
       consolidation_scope AS [Scope], revenue AS [Revenue], net_profit AS [Net profit],
       total_assets AS [Total assets], total_equity AS [Total equity],
       current_liabilities AS [Current liabilities], non_current_liabilities AS [Non-current liabilities],
       total_liabilities_and_equity AS [Liabilities + equity]
FROM selected ORDER BY ticker, fiscal_year DESC;

panels.title: Revenue · ${currency} millions
panels.description: Up to 20 company-year records ranked by revenue. Values divided by one million for display only; use the table for exact values.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT v.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY v.company_id, v.fiscal_year
               ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.consolidation_scope = 'consolidated' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                        v.period_end_date DESC, v.report_id DESC
           ) AS scope_rank
    FROM dbo.vw_fundamentals AS v
    WHERE v.market_source = 'kap_compare'
      AND v.fiscal_period = 4
      AND v.currency_code IN (${currency:sqlstring})
      AND v.ticker IN (${company:sqlstring})
      AND CAST(v.fiscal_year AS varchar(4)) IN (${year:sqlstring})

panels.title: Net profit margin · %
panels.description: Calculated as 100 × net profit / revenue. Zero revenue gives a missing ratio, not zero. Shows up to 20 records ranked by revenue.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT v.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY v.company_id, v.fiscal_year
               ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.consolidation_scope = 'consolidated' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                        v.period_end_date DESC, v.report_id DESC
           ) AS scope_rank
    FROM dbo.vw_fundamentals AS v
    WHERE v.market_source = 'kap_compare'
      AND v.fiscal_period = 4
      AND v.currency_code IN (${currency:sqlstring})
      AND v.ticker IN (${company:sqlstring})
      AND CAST(v.fiscal_year AS varchar(4)) IN (${year:sqlstring})
), selected AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE scope_rank = 1
)
SELECT TOP (20) CONCAT(ticker, ' / ', fiscal_year) AS [Company / year],
       100.0 * CAST(net_profit AS float) / NULLIF(CAST(revenue AS float), 0.0) AS [Net margin]
FROM selected ORDER BY revenue DESC, ticker, fiscal_year DESC;

options.content:
- **Data coverage:** annual KAP comparison exports only. One current valid version per company/year is displayed, with consolidated scope preferred.
- **Units:** the crawler already applies source scaling. Do not multiply table values by `currency_scale` again.
- **Across years:** amounts are as captured from each annual export; prior-period restatements and inflation effects are not harmonized by this dashboard.
- **Missing values:** a dash means unavailable or inapplicable. EBITDA, EPS, cash flow, cash balance, debt and share count are omitted because this crawler does not populate them.
- **Connection errors:** if the SQL connection tile reports `x509: negative serial number`, run the companion TLS fix and reload. Login or permission errors need datasource/account correction.
- **No rows:** check the currency, company and fiscal-year filters. The time-range picker is hidden because these queries use fiscal years.
